exact: disruption of host receptor-mediated signal transduction
negative regulation by symbiont of host receptor-mediated signal transduction
suppression by symbiont of host receptor-mediated signal transduction

definition: A process in which a virus interferes with, inhibits or disrupts a receptor-mediated signal transduction pathway in its host organism. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated suppression of host receptor-mediated signal transduction
